lines.text: When they arrived at Bethsaida, some people brought a blind man and begged Jesus to touch him.
Jesus took the blind man by the hand and led him out of the synagogue.
Jesus spit on the man's eyes and placed His hands on him, and the man said people looked like trees.
Jesus placed His hands on the man's eyes again, and his sight was restored so he could see everything clearly.
Jesus sent him to Capernaum and said, "Do not go back into the village."
